name: h2o_ccpvdz_grad
description: #550: h2o_ccpvdz_j's molecule and basis with PySCF's converged RHF (mo_energy, mo_occ, mo_coeff recorded; density and W = make_rdm1e from them), libcint's int1e_ipovlp / ipkin / ipnuc and int1e_iprinv at each nucleus, grad.rhf.get_jk's vj1 / vk1, each per-atom term of the RHF nuclear gradient (h, S/Pulay, J, K, V_nn) and nuc_grad_method().kernel()'s total.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate h2o_ccpvdz_grad

density_recipe: rhf: PySCF's converged closed-shell RHF density (total, 2 C_occ C_occ^T, symmetrised as (D + D^T) / 2; conv_tol 1e-12, conv_tol_grad 1e-10), recorded; every array is computed from the recorded matrix, which --check holds to 1e-08 of a fresh SCF, not bitwise
